dialogs.about: 호텔 방에서 할아버지와 없어진 지갑을 함께 찾아요

lines.en: My wallet is missing. Did you see it?
No. Where did you put it this morning?
lines.ko: 못 봤어요. 오늘 아침에 어디에 두었어요?

lines.en: I had it at the market an hour ago.
lines.ko: 한 시간 전에 시장에서 가지고 있었어요.

lines.en: Don't worry. Please look in your big bag first.
lines.ko: 걱정 마세요. 먼저 큰 가방 안을 봐 주세요.

lines.en: Oh! It is under my raincoat. I am sorry.
Don't apologize. We don't need the embassy now.
lines.ko: 사과하지 마세요. 이제 대사관에 갈 일이 없어요.

lines.en: I know. I wanted to call the helpline earlier.
lines.ko: 그러게요. 아까는 상담 전화를 걸고 싶었어요.

lines.en: Will you tell the hotel about it?
No. I have nothing to complain about now.
I am glad you found it. Let's rest now.

dialogs.about: 호텔 로비에서 안내원에게 셔틀에 두고 내린 가방을 물어봐요

lines.en: Excuse me. My small bag is missing.
Oh no. Where did you have it last?
I left it on the shuttle this afternoon.
I apologize. It is probably still on the shuttle.
lines.ko: 죄송해요. 아마 셔틀에 그대로 있을 거예요.

lines.en: Thank you. Do I need the embassy or a helpline?
Not now. I will call the shuttle driver.
lines.ko: 지금은 아니에요. 제가 셔틀 기사에게 전화할게요.

lines.en: Can you translate for me? My English is not good.
lines.ko: 저를 위해 통역해 줄 수 있어요? 제 영어가 좋지 않아요.

lines.en: Of course. I am happy to translate for you.
You are so kind. Thank you for helping me.
Good news! The driver found it a minute ago.
lines.ko: 좋은 소식이에요! 기사가 조금 전에 찾았어요.
